fields.description: System-wide deployment freeze on the rate master. While set, the rate-master WRITE endpoints refuse (CSV upload apply + the manual edit endpoints); the EXPORT and PREVIEW endpoints keep working, because the export is the action this freeze exists to protect. BoQ pricing is NOT affected -- no pricing path writes the rate master. Lifting is MANUAL ONLY: there is no expiry and no automatic lift. NOTE (owner ruling 2026-08-18): this covers the APP surface only, NOT Frappe Desk or the generic REST resource API -- an accepted gap, not an oversight.
fields.label: Frozen

fields.description: The user who last SET the freeze (frappe.session.user). Cleared on unfreeze. Typed Data (not Link) to match the BoQ Sheet lock/freeze/override precedent. Who LIFTED a freeze is recorded by the Version audit, not here -- this doctype is track_changes:1 and every flip goes through doc.save.
fields.label: Frozen By

fields.description: When the freeze was last set (now_datetime()). Cleared on unfreeze. The Rate Master banner renders this as ELAPSED time.
fields.label: Frozen At
